full_judgment: 9. The trial Court, on examination of the materials on record and on hearing all the parties dismissed the suit on contest by judgment and decree dated 24.08.1996 whereupon the plaintiffs preferred Title Appeal No. 92 of 1996 before the learned District Judge, Gopalganj, who allowed the appeal in part and thereby decreed the suit declaring that the plaintiffs have got title and possession in respect of 3.29 acres of land on the basis of their purchase vide kabala dated 04.02.1954(Exhibit-2) and accordingly, allotted saham to the plaintiffs for the said quantum of land (3.29 acres of land) by his judgment and decree dated 1.7.1997. Against the said judgment and decree of reversal, the defendant’s No. 1 and 2 moved the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 1034 of 1998 and obtained Rule. The High Court Division, on hearing the Rule, dis-charged the same by the impugned judgment and order dated 07.01.2010, observing that in Title Suit No. 4 of 1955 filed by the present defendants for permanent injunction against Samiruddin, (the predecessor of the plaintiffs), Court found Samiruddin's purchase of 3.29 acres of land from Konok Prova by kabala dated 4.2.1954 was valid and the said finding having been affirmed by the appellate Court as well as by the High Court Division the same is still subsisting. Moreover the SA record also stands in the name of Samiruddin and after his death in the names of the plaintiffs'.
